Adventure Island.name: Adventure Island
Adventure Island.description: Our ADVENTURE ISLAND combo features a large bouncing area and climbing wall with a water slide. Kids will love the color and fun their imaginations will have in this bounce-house combo. 20'W x 30'L x 17'H space needed.

Princess Castle.name: Princess Castle
Princess Castle.description: On the PRINCESS CASTLE, kids rule the kingdom with plenty of room for bouncing all day long. This Princess Castle also includes a slide for extra fun! This one is better for younger girls compared to our Princess Palace. 18'W × 20'L × 17'H space needed.

Princess Palace.name: Princess Palace
Princess Palace.description:
The PRINCESS PALACE bounce-house combo is perfect for your little princess! With its beautiful pink and purple design, spacious bouncing area, and slide, it will provide hours of fun for your royal guests! 

20'W × 30'L × 17'H space needed.

Wrecking Ball.name: Wrecking Ball
Wrecking Ball.description: The 5 Player Wrecking Ball is sure to entertain for hours at any event. Up to five players stand on the inflatable podiums and hurl the wrecking balls and try to knock opponents off their podiums. The rules are simple: last person standing wins! 25'W × 25'L × 20'H

Double Jump Shot.name: Double Jump Shot
Double Jump Shot.description: Step up your game and start shooting on the DOUBLE JUMP SHOT. Bright colors, two hoops and comes with two basketballs. Add this to any rental or get it by itself.

Gladiator Joust.name: Gladiator Joust
Gladiator Joust.description: The Gladiator Joust comes complete with headgear and a pair of jousting poles, ready to start your jousting tournament in minutes! Challenge your opponent by standing on the pedestals and try to knock them off with the poles. Last one standing wins! Great for larger groups and team building exercises. 25'W × 25'L × 20'H

Home Run Challenge.name: Home Run Challenge
Home Run Challenge.description: Home Run Challenge lets you experience the big leagues with these baseball-themed inflatable game. Players can step up to the plate and hit baseballs into an enclosed outfield.

Chair Metal Black.name: Chair Metal Black
Chair Metal Black.description: Black metal folding chairs for events.

Gift Card.name: Gift Card
Gift Card.description: Purchase a Jump CSRA gift card! Perfect for birthdays, holidays, or any special occasion. Choose between $50 and $100 denominations. Gift cards are valid for 1 year from purchase date and can be used toward any rental or service.

Beach Blast.name: Beach Blast
Beach Blast.description: Our BEACH BLAST waterslide features a 14ft tall water slide with a rush down to the inflatable pool at the bottom. This slide will be the hit of your weekend parties or midweek surprises. It's also available as a dry slide for all seasons or indoors. 20'W × 30'L × 18'H space needed.

Color Chaos.name: Color Chaos
Color Chaos.description: Get ready for all the fun your kids can handle on the 15 ft COLOR CHAOS waterslide. Brighter and more colorful than all the colors of summer. Book this amazing waterslide for your next event or party! 20'W × 30'L × 20'H space needed.

Fire and Ice.name: Fire and Ice
Fire and Ice.description: 22' FIRE AND ICE double waterslide  when you ride the wave through a slippery curve and launch into the water pool. With two lanes, race down the cool rapids and beat the heat and long lines at the water park. 40ft x 35ft space needed.

Fun in the Sun.name: Fun in the Sun
Fun in the Sun.description: Our FUN IN THE SUN waterslide features a 14ft tall water slide with a rush down to the inflatable pool at the bottom. This slide will be the hit of your weekend parties or midweek surprises. It's also available as a dry slide for all seasons or indoors. 20'W × 30'L × 18'H space needed.

Tidal Wave.name: Tidal Wave
Tidal Wave.description: This is it -- our biggest and baddest inflatable! Book the TIDAL WAVE if you want to have every neighbor stopping by and taking a look. Adults and kids will experience the ultimate thrill rush as they surf down the 27ft high slide and across the slip-n-slide before splashing in the pool. 80ft x 30ft space needed.
